tasks.label: LiteBox: Tail Audit Log
args: $dir = 'C:\src\litebox\target\litebox-audit'; while (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; $latest = Get-ChildItem $dir -Filter '*.jsonl' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($latest) { Write-Host "Tailing: $($latest.FullName)" -ForegroundColor DarkGray; Get-Content $latest.FullName -Wait -Tail 0 | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\{') { $_ | ConvertFrom-Json | Format-Table -AutoSize syscall, args, result } else { Write-Host $_ -ForegroundColor DarkGray } } } else { Write-Host 'No audit logs found yet.' }

tasks.label: LiteBox: Tail Audit Log (Pretty)
args: $dir = 'C:\src\litebox\target\litebox-audit'; while (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; $latest = Get-ChildItem $dir -Filter '*.jsonl' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($latest) { Write-Host "Tailing: $($latest.FullName)" -ForegroundColor DarkGray; Get-Content $latest.FullName -Wait -Tail 0 | & 'C:\src\litebox\litebox_tool_executor\scripts\View-AuditLog.ps1' } else { Write-Host 'No audit logs found yet.' }
